content.title: How to watch Golden State Valkyries on DirecTV
content.text: How to Watch Golden State Valkyries on DirecTV: Channel Guide, Streaming Access, and Blackout Info The Golden State Valkyries, the Bay Area’s freshly minted WNBA franchise, have quickly drawn attention as they prepare to make their debut. This addition marks a significant milestone in the league's expansion and reflects a broader surge in the visibility and support for women’s sports across the U.S. As viewership for the WNBA steadily climbs—with record-breaking ratings reported during the 2023 season—fans are looking for reliable ways to follow their favorite teams. DirecTV continues to serve as a premium destination for live sports, including professional basketball, offering robust coverage and multiple viewing options. This guide breaks down exactly how to catch every Golden State Valkyries game on DirecTV. You’ll find information on which channels to tune into, how to stream games through DirecTV-supported apps, blackout rule details, and tips for ensuring uninterrupted access throughout the season. Golden State Valkyries: Team Overview and League Impact Quick Stats: Launch, Arena, and Standout Talent The Golden State Valkyries joined the WNBA as an expansion team in 2025, becoming the league’s 13th franchise. Based in the vibrant San Francisco Bay Area, they play their home games at Chase Center — the same cutting-edge venue shared with the Golden State Warriors of the NBA. The arena seats over 18,000 and includes upgraded broadcast technology tailored for both NBA and WNBA coverage. Key players for the Valkyries include top 2025 WNBA Draft pick Avery Mitchell, a dominant guard from Stanford, as well as Yolanda Cruz, an international sensation from Spain known for her versatile forward play. Veteran center Jade Emerson brings playoff experience and leadership from her previous seasons with the Seattle Storm. Warriors Connection and Bay Area Identity The Valkyries share more than a building with the Warriors. Both teams operate under the umbrella of the Golden State Warriors organization, which provides resources, staff expertise, and a passionate fanbase. The synergy between the franchises creates crossover opportunities in marketing and community engagement, boosting visibility for women’s basketball in a region already rich in sports culture. In the Bay Area, where tech innovation meets heart-pounding sports legacy, the Valkyries have quickly cultivated a loyal following. From Oakland to San Jose, fans are investing in Valkyries gear, tuning in on local sports networks, and packing Chase Center for home matchups that carry palpable energy. Filling Out the WNBA Map With the addition of the Valkyries, the WNBA continues its strategic expansion, enhancing coast-to-coast rivalries and increasing the league’s national broadcast footprint. The team joins a competitive field that includes long-standing franchises like the: Phoenix Mercury – three-time WNBA champions and perennial playoff contenders Chicago Sky – 2021 champions with a growing Midwest fanbase Atlanta Dream – known for developing rising stars and cultivating a strong Southeastern following Minnesota Lynx – four-time champions and a cornerstone team in league history The Valkyries bring balance to the west coast presence, complementing the Las Vegas Aces and Los Angeles Sparks, and opening up more regional matchups for TV coverage and traveling fans. Their presence marks an intentional move by the WNBA to capitalize on major markets with proven basketball enthusiasm and broadcast demand. Who Owns the Screen? Decoding WNBA Broadcasting Rights National Partners Bringing the Game to Living Rooms Across the U.S. The WNBA’s primary national broadcast rights are split among three major networks: ESPN, ABC, and CBS Sports Network. Under the current agreement, ESPN holds the largest share, broadcasting up to 25 regular season games and all postseason matchups across its platforms, including ESPN2 and ESPNU. ABC, as part of the Disney network family, typically airs select high-profile weekend games. Meanwhile, CBS Sports Network, a key partner since 2019, carries at least 15 regular season games, focusing on additional national exposure. Regional and Local Coverage: Where the Valkyries Appear Off the National Grid When Golden State Valkyries games fall outside the national broadcast schedule, regional sports networks (RSNs) and local affiliates step in. These regional networks, often tied to the team’s geographic market, carry both home and away games. RSNs are determined through specific agreements—Bally Sports regional networks frequently carry WNBA games when a team is in their coverage footprint. Local stations may also occasionally pick up games, depending on market demand and scheduling. WNBA League Pass: Streaming All 12 Teams without Boundaries WNBA League Pass offers a direct-to-consumer option to watch out-of-market games. It provides live, full-season access to games not included in national broadcasts. This platform supports on-demand replays and condensed game versions, making it a strategic choice for viewers who want coverage beyond what national and regional networks provide. National networks like ESPN and CBS Sports carry marquee matchups and playoffs. Regional Sports Networks ensure coverage of games that fall outside the national spotlight. WNBA League Pass expands access to every non-national game, especially valuable for following multiple teams or out-of-market matchups. Each broadcasting partner brings a different layer of accessibility, forming a multi-platform structure that allows fans to watch games across TV and digital environments. Navigating this structure means understanding where each game lands in the broadcasting hierarchy. Curious where DirecTV fits into the picture? Let’s turn there next. Where to Find WNBA Games on DirecTV Primary Channels Broadcasting WNBA Games WNBA coverage on DirecTV spans several national and regional sports networks. To catch Golden State Valkyries games and other league matchups, viewers should watch the following channels: ESPN and ESPN2 – These flagship sports channels air a significant portion of nationally televised WNBA games, including the Commissioner’s Cup and playoffs. ABC – Selected Sunday games and marquee matchups appear on this free-to-air network, part of the ESPN family. CBS Sports Network – This channel carries regular season matchups throughout the summer and complements ESPN’s slate. Ion – Beginning with the 2023 season, Ion broadcasts Friday night WNBA doubleheaders as part of the league’s expanded national coverage. Bally Sports Bay Area – This is the regional sports network assigned to carry local Golden State Valkyries games throughout Northern California. Find Your Local Channel Numbers Channel numbers for these networks differ based on geographic location and your DirecTV package. For instance, ESPN typically appears on DirecTV channel 206, while CBS Sports Network can be found on channel 221 in most markets. However, Ion and Bally Sports Bay Area may occupy different slots depending on your ZIP code. To locate the exact channel numbers in your area, use the DirecTV Channel Lookup Tool. Enter your ZIP code and package to get a customized lineup that includes all WNBA broadcast partners. Explore the DirecTV Sports Channel Lineup DirecTV carries one of the most extensive portfolios of sports content among traditional satellite providers, offering a robust selection of regional and national networks that broadcast basketball games, including WNBA matchups. What's Included in DirecTV's Standard Sports Lineup? All DirecTV packages—from the basic Entertainment plan to the top-tier Premier—come with at least a core set of nationally recognized sports channels. Here’s what regularly features basketball-related content: ESPN and ESPN2 (Channels 206 and 209): Regularly feature WNBA games, including nationally televised matchups and playoff coverage. ABC (Varies by region): Broadcasts select high-profile WNBA games during the season. CBS Sports Network (Channel 221): Occasionally airs WNBA games, especially during the postseason. NBA TV (Channel 216): While focused mostly on the NBA, the network supplements its programming with WNBA coverage, analysis, and highlights. Basketball and the Sports Pack To gain access to even more basketball-centric programming, DirecTV offers the Sports Pack—an optional premium add-on that expands your channel lineup by over 40 additional regional and specialty sports channels. Among these, viewers might find more in-depth analysis, out-of-market coverage, and supplementary shows focused on women’s basketball. Regional Sports Networks (RSNs): These include Bally Sports regional feeds and NBC Sports regional networks (based on your location). ESPN College Extra and ACC Network: While focused on college athletics, they occasionally spotlight women’s sports stories and rising talent relevant to professional leagues like the WNBA. Regional Availability Factors Access to certain channels—especially RSNs like Bally Sports Bay Area—depends on your billing ZIP code. Subscribers in Northern California will typically receive Bally Sports Bay Area in their base package, enabling them to follow local team broadcasts, including Golden State Valkyries games, without additional fees. Outside of this market, fans won’t see this channel in their default lineup unless they subscribe to the Sports Pack or a comparable add-on that unlocks out-of-region RSNs. Wondering whether your ZIP qualifies? DirecTV’s online channel lookup tool provides precise details based on location. Stream Golden State Valkyries Games Live with DirecTV Watch the Valkyries Anytime, Anywhere with the DirecTV App The DirecTV app offers seamless access to live television, including Golden State Valkyries games, for subscribers on the move. As a mobile companion to DirecTV’s satellite service, the platform mirrors live broadcasts from regional sports networks such as Bally Sports Bay Area—when available in your subscription area. To stream games through the DirecTV app, simply log in using your DirecTV account credentials. Once authenticated, you'll gain access to live channels based on your current package and location. Compatible Devices for DirecTV Streaming Smart TVs: Samsung and LG models that support the DirecTV Stream app can run broadcasts without additional hardware. Mobile and tablets: iOS and Android devices allow for on-the-go watching through the DirecTV app available in Apple App Store and Google Play. Streaming media players: Roku, Amazon Fire TV, and Apple TV all support streaming Valkyries games via the DirecTV Stream app interface. Web browser: Desktop access is possible through the DirecTV website using Chrome, Safari, or Firefox. Understand Regional Accessibility and Log-In Requirements Access to Valkyries broadcasts on DirecTV hinges on your market location. Because DirecTV uses geo-targeting to enforce regional sports network availability, users outside Northern California may face restrictions based on broadcast rights. Bally Sports Bay Area, which typically carries Valkyries home games, only streams live in-market. National broadcasts remain accessible wherever the DirecTV package includes the relevant channel (such as ESPN or ABC). Before streaming, users must complete a one-time login using their DirecTV credentials. This login syncs your package entitlements to the app, unlocking live sports content, including WNBA matchups. Ready to catch the Valkyries in action without being tied to your living room? Launch the DirecTV app and start streaming wherever your game day takes you. Choose the Right DirecTV Package for Maximum WNBA Coverage Comparing DirecTV Packages: What Sports Fans Need to Know DirecTV offers four primary residential packages—Entertainment, Choice, Ultimate, and Premier—each with a different level of sports programming. Not all packages grant access to regional sports networks like Bally Sports Bay Area or national broadcasters carrying WNBA games, so selection matters. Entertainment Package: The base package includes over 75 channels but lacks regional sports networks and many national sports channels. Bally Sports Bay Area is not included. Choice Package: This is the threshold for serious sports content. With 105+ channels, it includes Bally Sports Bay Area and other regional networks. It also features national channels like ESPN and ESPN2, both of which broadcast WNBA games. Ultimate Package: Expands to 140+ channels, adding specialty sports content including CBS Sports Network and FS1. It includes everything from the Choice package, making it suitable for viewers who follow multiple leagues or sports genres. Premier Package: The premium tier comes with over 150 channels, integrating all sports networks included in the Ultimate package plus premium movie channels such as HBO and Showtime. It doesn’t add much in terms of incremental sports coverage beyond Ultimate, unless you're bundling for entertainment. National WNBA Coverage: What Networks Are Included? WNBA games air nationally on ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, CBS, CBS Sports Network, and NBA TV. All these channels are available in the DirecTV Choice package or higher. NBA TV, however, is not automatically included in every package and requires an add-on for full access. Enhance Sports Access with Add-Ons Sports Pack: This $14.99/month add-on unlocks over 40 additional regional and specialty sports networks. NBA TV is part of this add-on, making it essential for fans who want to watch out-of-market games or additional WNBA content beyond standard broadcasts. NBA League Pass: Although focused on NBA content, DirecTV occasionally offers WNBA-related shoulder programming under this umbrella. Available as a seasonal purchase, it's not necessary for Valkyries coverage but could appeal to broader hoop fans. Start with the Choice package if local Valkyries broadcasts and national WNBA coverage are your primary interest. Upgrade to Ultimate or Premier if you're following a wider range of leagues or want more comprehensive sports access across the board. Golden State Valkyries: When and Where to Catch Every Game Where to Access the Full Game Schedule Keeping up with the Golden State Valkyries' game calendar requires checking a few reliable sources. Each season brings a mix of electrifying home performances and key away games, and the full slate is updated consistently across these platforms: Team's Official Website – goldstatevalkyries.com/schedule lists all games, including TV broadcast info and ticket links. WNBA.com – Visit the league's schedule page to view the Valkyries' games across national and regional networks. DirecTV Channel Guide – Log in to your DirecTV account or access the on-screen channel guide to see upcoming Valkyries games by date and channel. Highlighted Matchups on the 2024 Schedule Several key clashes stand out on this season's schedule. These aren't just games—they're stakes-laden showdowns with playoff implications and high fan energy. Add them to your calendar: Phoenix Mercury – Expect intensity when the Valkyries square off against Phoenix. Their rivalry traces back to fierce Western Conference battles and features superstar matchups in every quarter. Chicago Sky – When the Valkyries face Chicago, East meets West in technically sharp, tactically deep contests. These games often involve clutch-time heroics and highlight-reel performances. Atlanta Dream – Atlanta brings athleticism and speed, and the Valkyries counter with size and shooting. Their meetings have often gone down to the wire, making them must-watch events. Minnesota Lynx – Minnesota games mark a test of depth and defense. The Lynx tradition of strong post play contrasts against the Valkyries' perimeter attack, setting up thrilling chess matches on court. Bookmark the team's schedule page, monitor broadcasts on your DirecTV guide, and plan ahead to ensure you're tuned in for every key matchup of the season. Stream Golden State Valkyries Games with the DirecTV App Step-by-Step: How to Watch the Valkyries on the Go Streaming WNBA action from the DirecTV app gives you full mobility without sacrificing access. Whether you're commuting or sitting at a café, here's how to catch Golden State Valkyries games directly on your device. Download and Install: Grab the DirecTV app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. The app supports iOS, Android, tablets, and select smart TVs. Sign In: Open the app and log in using your DirecTV TV provider credentials. Without verifying your subscription, live streams won't be available. Find Live Games: Use the search bar to look for "Golden State Valkyries," or browse the live TV guide within the app. Games airing on Bally Sports and ESPN networks appear in real time. Use the channel guide for an overview of all upcoming programs, or set alerts to notify you when Valkyries games are about to begin. Don't Miss a Moment: Stream with DVR and On-Demand Features The DirecTV app syncs with your home DVR, including Genie HD DVR, allowing full access to recorded games while you're away. If you missed tipoff, just open your recorded content and pick up where the game left off. Additionally, select WNBA games offer on-demand replays. Within the app, navigate to the sports or network tab, choose the game, and start watching. Replays become available typically within 24 hours of the event airing. Quick Recap for Mobile Streaming Install the DirecTV app on your device. Log in using your DirecTV credentials. Search for Valkyries games or use the live TV guide. Stream live, replay recorded games, or watch on-demand replays. Using the DirecTV app transforms how you follow the Valkyries—no cable box, just basketball anywhere you go. Your Ultimate Viewing Playbook for the Golden State Valkyries DirecTV delivers full-court coverage for Golden State Valkyries fans, combining regional broadcasts, league-wide coverage, and flexible streaming tools into one seamless platform. With channels like Bally Sports Bay Area and national networks such as ESPN and CBS Sports Network, you can watch every Valkyries matchup—home or away—without hopping between services or missing tipoff. Instead of following the schedule on social media or relying on next-day highlights, locking in the right DirecTV package ensures live, in-market access with high-definition quality. Bally Sports Bay Area’s availability on DirecTV places you courtside for every buzzer-beater inside Chase Center. National games—especially late-season matchups and playoffs—air across your existing satellite lineup with zero extra effort. Already a DirecTV subscriber? Make the most of it. Use the DirecTV app for streaming on the go, record games with your DVR, and follow the WNBA with integrated scheduling features. Not yet subscribed? Opt for a plan with regional sports coverage, and activate streaming access to unlock flexibility and control. The energy inside the WNBA is rising. Fans across the country are tuning in, and Bay Area supporters have a front-row seat to one of the league’s newest—and most exciting—franchises. Take part in it. Watch the Golden State Valkyries, follow every game like a pro, and champion the momentum around women’s basketball like never before.
